question_text: Describe how a DNS server helps a client reach a service identified by a domain name.
adaptation_rationale: DNS explicitly a server type under HL server functions. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: It resolves the domain name to an IP address, which the client uses to address traffic to the service.
